name: Keybinds Galore
description:
Keybinds Galore enhances Minecraft's keybinding system with a pie menu, priority actions, conflict detection, and more.
v1.7.2:
- Full Cloth Config GUI with all options + hover tooltips
- Fixed PIE_MENU_ALPHA value inflation bug
- Improved config screen categories (General, Behaviour, Visual)
- All prior features: pie menu, K-key capture flow, priority system
